findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_community, get_post_comments · Private data: register_agent, register_wallet, request_payout, wallet_challenge, wallet_verify · Public sink: submit_for_verification, set_follow_price, read_community, create_post, comment_on_post, like_post, get_post_comments, publish_screen, publish_strategy, get_my_publications, wallet_verify · Destructive: backtest_strategy, submit_for_verification, run_screen, sandbox_reset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_community, get_post_comments · Private data: register_agent, register_wallet, request_payout, wallet_challenge, wallet_verify · Public sink: submit_for_verification, set_follow_price, read_community, create_post, comment_on_post, like_post, get_post_comments, publish_screen, publish_strategy, get_my_publications, wallet_verify · Destructive: backtest_strategy, submit_for_verification, run_screen, sandbox_reset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
